title: Roles inspector: compact role & permission overview with audit links
creator: Amira Chen
description: Goal: Design a compact, scannable 'Roles Inspector' panel in Console that lets admins understand a role's effective permissions, recent audit events, and member assignments at a glance. This ticket focuses on the design surface for role rows (list + compact inspector drawer), the permission-summary UI (aggregated chips, hover details), quick member-assignment flows, and a persistent audit link that opens the audit-log filtered to this role. Success criteria: (1) Admins can decide whether to modify or assign a role within 30s without leaving the inspector; (2) role-to-permission mapping is clear for composite roles and SSO-mapped roles; (3) audit links surface the last 10 interactions tied to the role; (4) accessible and keyboard-navigable.
design_decisions: Show permissions as grouped chips: top-level capabilities (Read, Write, Manage) + domain badges (Runtime, Models, Billing)
Use condensed rows with a right-edge 'Inspector' affordance that opens a slide-over rather than navigating to a separate page
Expose an inline 'Assign members' quick action that opens a searchable multi-select with SSO sync hint
Audit CTA opens audit-log in a new tab with pre-applied filters (role=<role_id>), plus an inline preview of the last 3 events in the inspector
Require sudo re-auth (modal) for role-changing actions when admin is not in elevated mode
tradeoffs: Compact view reduces discoverability for very large permission sets — mitigated by 'Show more' expansion and hover details
Slide-over keeps context but increases DOM complexity; engineering recommends virtualization to keep perf acceptable
Inline member assign reduces clicks but may encourage broad assignments; we add a confirmation if >50 members selected
open_questions: Should composite role inheritance be expanded inline or collapsed with a link to details?
What exact audit event attributes do security teams expect in the inline preview? (timestamp, actor, action, ip)
How to visually indicate SSO-mapped roles vs local roles without overloading the row?
accessibility_notes: Inspector must be fully keyboard operable (open/close, move between permission chips)
Permission chip colors need WCAG AA contrast; provide a text fallback and tooltip for colorblind users
Provide ARIA labels for audit-preview rows and confirm dialogs for mass-assign actions

2025-11-06 — Jonah Patel (Design): Consolidated permission groups and created hover states for chip detail. Left question about composite role expansion. @Maeve (Engineering) to advise on virtualization options.

2025-11-10 — Maeve O'Neill (Engineering): Suggested virtualization and lazy-loading of audit preview; warned that inline audit previews must be capped to 3 events to avoid query costs. Proposed endpoint filter: /audit?role_id=<id>&limit=3

2025-11-12 — Priya Das (Product): PM review: agreed with compact slide-over approach, requested that SSO-mapped roles have a subtle badge and a tooltip with last sync time. Prioritize member-assign confirmation for orgs with >1000 users.

2025-11-15 — Security (review): Inline preview needs to include actor_id and action_type. Require link to full audit event with raw JSON export in new tab. Flagged for formal security review (ticket SE-5521).

2025-11-20 — Jonah Patel (Design): Updated mid-fi in Figma to include 'Show more' for permission expansion, added sudo modal for role edits, and created accessibility checklist. Ready for design review on 2025-11-22.

Add copy for SSO sync tooltip and sudo re-auth modal; pass to Content for review

review_feedback: Priya Das (PM): Keep default inspector collapsed for existing users; make expansion discoverable via keyboard shortcut K+R
Maeve O'Neill (Eng): Need API perf SLAs for audit previews. If latency >200ms, hide preview and show retry CTA
Security Team: Require a link to the event JSON and ensure RBAC checks on the audit API to prevent info leakage
